name: Hornbound
description: In this roguelike adventure, you play as a Unicorn on a quest to find the missing rainbows. Explore, survive, and collect them all!

scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/dev.ts
scripts.gen:sfx: audiosprite -f howler2 -o ./res/sfx --path '${RES_DIR}' -e mp3 ./misc/sfx/*.* && npm run gen:types
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/build_web.ts --debug
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/build_web.ts
scripts.build:node-dev: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/build_node.ts --debug
scripts.build:node: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/build_node.ts
scripts.build:native: npm run clean && npm run type-check && node ./build/build_node.ts --sea

author: Karthik Jayakumar
